snippet.title: Roselle Hunt - PvPvE Backpack Auto-Battler | Official Teaser
snippet.description:
Roselle Hunt - a PvPvE backpack auto-battler. Loot, combine, obliterate. Then find the thief who started it all.

🛒 Wishlist now on Steam 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4331790/Roselle_Hunt/

Welcome to the modular city. Your job: track down ROSELLE, the runaway thief - and whatever she stole. Step into the filthy shoes of five despicable bounty hunters who ditched their morals a long time ago.

Stack junk into your backpack, chain absurd synergies, and unleash a hellstorm of effects on your rivals. But here's the twist: every move you make spawns a ghost — and that ghost hunts other players. Then their ghosts come for you. A vicious, endless cycle of asynchronous PvP with no mercy.

🔥 WHAT'S INSIDE:
- 600+ items with deep, exponential synergies
- 280+ perks that can flip your entire build in an instant
- 5+ playable scoundrels, each with their own twisted ambitions
- Asynchronous PvP - battle the ghosts of real players
- Ranked Arena + Story Hunt
- A hand-drawn 2D world dripping with dark humor

WE. NEED. ROSELLE.

🛒 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4331790/Roselle_Hunt/
🐦 Follow the hunt on X: https://x.com/chertobook
